sql:
/*
================================================================================
项目：蜡笔小新首日创角 cohort LTV1 / LTV2 对比（繁体 CBT vs 新加坡 Android）
口径：
  - LTV1：创角自然日内有效充值累计收入 / 首日创角人数。
  - LTV2：创角自然日及次日累计有效充值收入 / 首日创角人数。
  - 繁体 LTV2 为 2026-07-30 当前可见数据的临时值；新加坡 Android 为成熟基准。
  - 充值排除 sandbox、is_freebuy，并使用每日汇率换算 USD。
================================================================================
*/
WITH TC_Blacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SG_Blacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SG_Android AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name = 'fixed_os' AND tag_value = 'Android'
),
SG_Singapore AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name = 'fixed_country' AND tag_value = '新加坡'
),
CohortUsers AS (
    SELECT
        '繁体CBT' AS cohort_name,
        DATE '2026-07-29' AS cohort_date,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN TC_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND v."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND v."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        '新加坡Android' AS cohort_name,
        DATE '2026-05-08' AS cohort_date,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_13 v
    INNER JOIN SG_Android a ON v."#user_id" = a.user_id
    INNER JOIN SG_Singapore s ON v."#user_id" = s.user_id
    LEFT JOIN SG_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND v."$part_date" = '2026-05-08'
      AND v."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
PaymentEvents AS (
    SELECT
        '繁体CBT' AS cohort_name,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        CAST(v."$part_date" AS DATE) AS pay_date,
        TRY_CAST(v.pay_amount AS DOUBLE) / COALESCE(x.exchange, 1) AS revenue_usd
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN TC_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x
      ON v."$part_date" = x.ex_date AND v.pay_currency = x.currency
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-30'
      AND (v.sandbox IS NULL OR v.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (v.is_freebuy IS NULL OR v.is_freebuy = FALSE)
      AND b.user_id IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        '新加坡Android' AS cohort_name,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        CAST(v."$part_date" AS DATE) AS pay_date,
        TRY_CAST(v.pay_amount AS DOUBLE) / COALESCE(x.exchange, 1) AS revenue_usd
    FROM ta.v_event_13 v
    INNER JOIN SG_Android a ON v."#user_id" = a.user_id
    INNER JOIN SG_Singapore s ON v."#user_id" = s.user_id
    LEFT JOIN SG_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x
      ON v."$part_date" = x.ex_date AND v.pay_currency = x.currency
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-05-08' AND '2026-05-09'
      AND (v.sandbox IS NULL OR v.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (v.is_freebuy IS NULL OR v.is_freebuy = FALSE)
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
LtvWindows AS (
    SELECT 1 AS ltv_day, 'LTV1' AS ltv_name
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2 AS ltv_day, 'LTV2' AS ltv_name
),
LtvAgg AS (
    SELECT
        c.cohort_name,
        c.cohort_date,
        w.ltv_day,
        w.ltv_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.account_id) AS cohort_users,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.account_id END) AS cumulative_payers,
        SUM(COALESCE(p.revenue_usd, 0)) AS cumulative_revenue_usd
    FROM CohortUsers c
    CROSS JOIN LtvWindows w
    LEFT JOIN PaymentEvents p
      ON c.cohort_name = p.cohort_name
     AND c.account_id = p.account_id
     AND p.pay_date BETWEEN c.cohort_date AND DATE_ADD('day', w.ltv_day - 1, c.cohort_date)
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
)
SELECT
    cohort_name AS "用户组",
    CAST(cohort_date AS VARCHAR) AS "创角日期",
    ltv_name AS "LTV周期",
    cohort_users AS "创角人数",
    cumulative_payers AS "累计付费人数",
    ROUND(100.0 * cumulative_payers / NULLIF(cohort_users, 0), 2) AS "累计付费率(%)",
    ROUND(cumulative_revenue_usd, 2) AS "累计收入(USD)",
    ROUND(cumulative_revenue_usd / NULLIF(cohort_users, 0), 4) AS "LTV(USD)",
    CASE
        WHEN cohort_name = '繁体CBT' AND ltv_day = 2 THEN '临时值：7月30日自然日未结束'
        ELSE '已成熟'
    END AS "成熟状态",
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS VARCHAR) AS "刷新时间"
FROM LtvAgg
ORDER BY 1, 3;
